## What the pak can change

Members of `zzzzzzzzzz_coop_m3l2ground.pk3`:

- `CREDITS_m3l2ground.txt`
- `maps/m3l2.bsp`
- `scripts/hzm_m3l2_ground.shader`
- `textures/hzm_m3l2/farmyard.dds`
- `textures/hzm_m3l2/farmyard.jpg`
- `textures/hzm_m3l2/road.dds`
- `textures/hzm_m3l2/road.jpg`

Members that already exist in the player stack (i.e. override something): `maps/m3l2.bsp` (main\Pak5.pk3)

Every other member is a NEW name. A BSP can only draw a shader it names:

- player-stack BSPs that name `textures/hzm_m3l2/*`: **none**
- the patched `maps/m3l2.bsp` names them: yes
- Omaha maps in the pak: **none**
- Omaha-named members (omaha/ocean/seabed/wetsand/shoreline/surf/wake): **none**
- `zzzzzzzzzz_coop_hd_m3l1a.pk3`, the dday2 sky: not read, not written, not overridden.

**Conclusion:** the only file this pak overrides is m3l2's own map; every texture/shader it adds is a new name only that map uses. No other map - Omaha included - can render anything different.
